title: The feed
description: Outfits from every brand at once, packed into one endless grid. The whole idea of Fitkit, and it is live.

title: First brands listed
description: A founding set of independent labels uploaded their catalogs and went out to shoppers.

title: Buyable looks
description: Every piece in a post carries its own purchase link, so a look is one tap from the brand that made it.

title: Curation engine
description: Building sets out of pieces from different brands, and putting each set in front of the buyer most likely to want it.

title: Self-serve listing
description: Upload a catalog, add your links, be live the same afternoon — without a call with us first.

title: Brand dashboard
description: Impressions, taps and sales per piece, so listing with us is something you can measure rather than hope about.

title: Saved sets
description: Shoppers keep the looks they love, and brands find out which of their pieces keep turning up in them.

title: Fitkit on Android
description: The app on Android, feature for feature with iOS.
